<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta
      name="viewport"
      content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover"
    />
    <meta name="theme-color" content="#101c2e" />
    <title>One Month hehe</title>
    <style>
      :root {
        color-scheme: dark;
        --ink: #f3f6fb;
        --muted: #a9b7c9;
        --blue: #93d6ff;
        --night: #0b1422;
      }

      * {
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }

      html,
      body {
        width: 100%;
        min-height: 100%;
        margin: 0;
      }

      body {
        min-height: 100vh;
        min-height: 100svh;
        overflow: hidden;
        color: var(--ink);
        background:
          radial-gradient(
            circle at 50% 40%,
            rgba(63, 106, 141, 0.22),
            transparent 34rem
          ),
          radial-gradient(
            circle at 12% 92%,
            rgba(104, 160, 198, 0.1),
            transparent 28rem
          ),
          var(--night);
        font-family:
          ui-sans-serif,
          system-ui,
          -apple-system,
          BlinkMacSystemFont,
          "Segoe UI",
          sans-serif;
        -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        touch-action: manipulation;
      }

      button {
        font: inherit;
        color: inherit;
      }

      .experience {
        position: relative;
        display: grid;
        min-height: 100vh;
        min-height: 100svh;
        place-items: center;
        padding: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-top))
          max(18px, env(safe-area-inset-right))
          max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom))
          max(18px, env(safe-area-inset-left));
        isolation: isolate;
      }

      .experience::before,
      .experience::after {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: -1;
        width: 18rem;
        height: 18rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(172, 218, 248, 0.12);
        border-radius: 50%;
        content: "";
        pointer-events: none;
      }

      .experience::before {
        top: -8rem;
        left: -8rem;
        box-shadow:
          0 0 0 3.5rem rgba(172, 218, 248, 0.025),
          0 0 0 7rem rgba(172, 218, 248, 0.018);
      }

      .experience::after {
        right: -10rem;
        bottom: -10rem;
        box-shadow:
          0 0 0 4rem rgba(172, 218, 248, 0.025),
          0 0 0 8rem rgba(172, 218, 248, 0.018);
      }

      .card-stage {
        position: relative;
        width: min(92vw, 560px, calc((100svh - 48px) * 0.5625));
        aspect-ratio: 1080 / 1920;
        filter: drop-shadow(0 28px 46px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36));
      }

      .page-shell {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: clamp(10px, 2.2vw, 18px);
        background: #edf0f1;
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      }

      .page-art {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        object-fit: contain;
        user-select: none;
        -webkit-user-drag: none;
      }

      .calendar-shell {
        z-index: 2;
      }

      .calendar-shell.is-exiting {
        animation: calendarCrumble 1150ms cubic-bezier(0.76, 0.05, 0.79, 0.31)
          forwards;
        pointer-events: none;
      }

      .calendar-shell.is-exiting .calendar-hotspot {
        animation: hotspotPulse 650ms ease-out both;
      }

      .calendar-hotspot {
        position: absolute;
        left: 2.7%;
        top: 54.55%;
        width: 7.8%;
        height: 4.9%;
        padding: 0;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: transparent;
        cursor: pointer;
        outline: none;
        touch-action: manipulation;
        -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
      }

      .calendar-hotspot::after {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 14%;
        border-radius: 50%;
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(150, 221, 255, 0);
        content: "";
        transition: box-shadow 180ms ease;
      }

      .calendar-hotspot:hover::after,
      .calendar-hotspot:focus-visible::after {
        box-shadow: 0 0 20px 7px rgba(150, 221, 255, 0.34);
      }

      .calendar-hotspot:focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid rgba(171, 226, 255, 0.92);
        outline-offset: 4px;
      }

      .certificate-shell {
        z-index: 1;
        visibility: hidden;
        opacity: 0;
        background: #000;
      }

      .certificate-shell.is-live {
        visibility: visible;
        opacity: 1;
      }

      .certificate-shell.is-entering {
        animation: certificateCrumbleIn 1250ms
          cubic-bezier(0.17, 0.85, 0.35, 1.02) both;
      }

      .scratch-canvas {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        cursor: crosshair;
        touch-action: none;
        user-select: none;
        -webkit-user-select: none;
        -webkit-touch-callout: none;
        -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
      }

      .scratch-canvas.is-clearing {
        animation: coatingLift 760ms ease-in forwards;
        pointer-events: none;
      }

      .replay {
        position: fixed;
        right: max(18px, env(safe-area-inset-right));
        bottom: max(18px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
        z-index: 10;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 7px;
        padding: 9px 13px 9px 12px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(186, 226, 249, 0.32);
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: rgba(15, 29, 46, 0.72);
        box-shadow:
          0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24),
          inset 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
        color: #eff8ff;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 650;
        letter-spacing: 0.01em;
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(9px);
        pointer-events: none;
        cursor: pointer;
        backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
        transition:
          opacity 400ms ease,
          transform 400ms ease,
          background 180ms ease;
      }

      .replay.is-visible {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
        pointer-events: auto;
      }

      .replay:hover,
      .replay:focus-visible {
        background: rgba(38, 71, 98, 0.86);
      }

      .replay:focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--blue);
        outline-offset: 3px;
      }

      .transition-field,
      .celebration-field {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 8;
        overflow: hidden;
        pointer-events: none;
      }

      .transition-bit,
      .celebration-bit {
        position: absolute;
        left: 50%;
        top: 50%;
        display: block;
        color: var(--blue);
        font-size: clamp(12px, 2.6vw, 22px);
        line-height: 1;
        opacity: 0;
        text-shadow: 0 0 15px currentColor;
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.4) rotate(0);
      }

      .transition-field.is-active .transition-bit {
        animation: floatAway var(--duration) cubic-bezier(0.15, 0.78, 0.26, 1)
          var(--delay) both;
      }

      .celebration-field.is-active .celebration-bit {
        animation: celebrate var(--duration) cubic-bezier(0.15, 0.78, 0.26, 1)
          var(--delay) both;
      }

      @keyframes hotspotPulse {
        0%,
        100% {
          filter: drop-shadow(0 0 0 rgba(155, 226, 255, 0));
        }
        25% {
          filter: drop-shadow(0 0 13px rgba(155, 226, 255, 0.95));
        }
        55% {
          filter: drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(155, 226, 255, 0.56));
        }
      }

      @keyframes calendarCrumble {
        0% {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) rotate(0) scale(1);
          clip-path: inset(0);
        }
        32% {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: translate3d(-1.5%, -1%, 0) rotate(-0.8deg) scale(1.008);
          clip-path: inset(0 0 7% 0);
        }
        68% {
          opacity: 0.78;
          transform: translate3d(3%, 6%, 0) rotate(2deg) scale(0.98);
          clip-path: polygon(
            0 0,
            100% 0,
            97% 28%,
            100% 58%,
            93% 100%,
            55% 96%,
            23% 100%,
            0 84%
          );
        }
        100% {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: translate3d(-5%, 14%, 0) rotate(-4deg) scale(0.9);
          clip-path: polygon(
            0 0,
            83% 0,
            75% 17%,
            100% 29%,
            75% 44%,
            90% 68%,
            59% 62%,
            35% 100%,
            15% 74%,
            0 88%
          );
        }
      }

      @keyframes certificateCrumbleIn {
        0% {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: scale(0.9) rotate(1.2deg);
          clip-path: polygon(
            0 100%,
            17% 88%,
            30% 100%,
            48% 89%,
            65% 100%,
            82% 86%,
            100% 100%
          );
          filter: blur(2px);
        }
        52% {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: scale(1.014) rotate(-0.3deg);
          clip-path: polygon(
            0 14%,
            11% 0,
            26% 6%,
            45% 0,
            64% 5%,
            84% 0,
            100% 13%,
            95% 52%,
            100% 87%,
            84% 100%,
            60% 94%,
            39% 100%,
            16% 94%,
            0 100%
          );
          filter: blur(0.4px);
        }
        100% {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: scale(1) rotate(0);
          clip-path: inset(0);
          filter: blur(0);
        }
      }

      @keyframes coatingLift {
        0% {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: scale(1);
        }
        64% {
          opacity: 0.82;
          transform: scale(1.006);
        }
        100% {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: scale(1.012);
        }
      }

      @keyframes floatAway {
        0% {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.35) rotate(0);
        }
        15% {
          opacity: 0.88;
        }
        100% {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: translate(calc(-50% + var(--x)), calc(-50% + var(--y)))
            scale(1) rotate(var(--rotation));
        }
      }

      @keyframes celebrate {
        0% {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.3) rotate(0);
        }
        15% {
          opacity: 0.95;
        }
        100% {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: translate(calc(-50% + var(--x)), calc(-50% + var(--y)))
            scale(0.9) rotate(var(--rotation));
        }
      }

      @media (max-width: 520px) {
        .card-stage {
          width: min(94vw, calc((100svh - 38px) * 0.5625));
        }
      }

      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        *,
        *::before,
        *::after {
          animation-duration: 1ms !important;
          animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
          scroll-behavior: auto !important;
          transition-duration: 1ms !important;
        }
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <main
      class="experience"
      aria-label="Interactive one month anniversary card"
    >
      <div class="card-stage" id="cardStage">
        <section
          class="page-shell calendar-shell"
          id="calendarShell"
          aria-label="August calendar"
        >
          <img
            class="page-art"
            src="data:image/png;base64,
